statements.statement: The superintendent said funding for the special education stabilization fund may need to proceed through the district's regular FY27 budget development process rather than a separate town meeting appropriation from free cash, pending confirmation from DESE.
A member proposed using unexpended FY26 appropriations (closeout funds) to fund the special education stabilization reserve, contingent on it being a legal funding mechanism.

The superintendent said the financial component of the outside financial review needs to be completed before budget season because accurate numbers will affect how the district approaches building next year's budget.
